title: VorpalFusion
description: The picture develops while you type: any template, live on your own GPU, settling to full quality when the words rest.

licenses.workflow: the template the creator chooses, under its own licence
licenses.models: as listed by that template; the speed-up assets below under theirs

runs_on.note: The live profile comes from the template's slots (profile.py): a quarter megapixel, a quarter of its steps (at least 4), enhancers off, a 2 s clip. The settle refines the live frame at the template's size (decoded, resized in pixel space, encoded, refined), or renders the template unchanged where it cannot.

sidecar.vram_note: Dynamic VRAM has no pin, and an idle process keeps what it staged: Saddle starts every other ComfyUI on the card with --vram-headroom 16 (one live family resident: Z-Image int8 with its encoder about 14.5 GB, FLUX 3 Klein about 11 GB, plus 2)

ladder.hires_note: Measured both ways (checks/ladder.py, README 'The ladder, measured'): Saddle's SeedVR2 upscale tool adds detail the tiled refine smooths away, at 2-6x less GPU time; a template may name 'refine' (Lanczos, tiled encode, its sampler at denoise 0.3, tiled decode) instead.

thin_drafts.note: Templates whose draft thins a hand-written schedule (ManualSigmas) to the live-steps count (profile.thinned), measured against the template's own knots on the same seeds (RTX 5090): Pika H3 Flex six steps at four, SSIM to the six-step draft 0.52-0.94 where another seed scores 0.43-0.71, and the same composition; 0.4 s off a 1.8 s text-to-video draft. LTX 2.5's thinned stages recompose the picture (SSIM at the other-seed floor), so it is not listed.

finetunes_note: Fine-tunes of a template's own model file, offered as its Model choice where the template uses `replaces` and the endpoint has `name` in `folder`: {name, folder, replaces, label}. A user's own entries go in ~/.config/gpu-vision/finetunes.json (the same shape), read beside these.
edit_templates_note: The family's edit template per text-to-image template: F (pin as reference) puts the picture on stage into the edit template's first picture slot and switches to it.

assets.name: taeh3.safetensors
assets.for: MiniMax H3 and FastH3; a draft clip decodes its frames with it (0.26 s off a 3.8 s FastH3 draft, the sound unchanged)

assets.name: z_image_turbo_int8_convrot.safetensors
assets.for: Z-Image Turbo, live and settle: half the weights, 17 % faster at 0.25 MP, 0.99 like bf16 on the same seeds (checks/precision.py)

not_imported: Live runs are not plans: they render at live size while the Live switch is on and the GPU is free, and none enters the library. Keep stages the settled frame as a normal plan.
choices_made_here: Latest wins: a live job runs out and the next takes the newest words, so frames never queue; a new template or picture stops it, and typing stops only the settle.
Words go out on a word boundary (the first word as it is typed) and whole once the keys rest 250 ms; the settle waits for the whole words.
A live image's graph stops at the sampler: its frame is the last step preview, so ComfyUI decodes nothing and writes no PNG for it.
Every job carries a label in its graph (gpu-vision, sidecar, lane), so the loop knows whose job is ahead and idle work yields.
No silence goes unexplained: a job silent for 1 s, or words with no frame for 1.5 s, say what they wait on.
Choosing a template or a picture warms it with a 1-step job, so the first typed frame does not pay the load.
The settle upscales in pixel space (decode, Lanczos, encode, refine): a latent upscale cracked faces on FLUX 3.
Every frame carries the state version it was made for; the page drops frames for an older template or picture and dims a picture whose words moved on.
A clip loops and each new draft flows in at the playhead, so motion carries on rather than restarting.
The ladder climbs one picture, never a new one: every rung keeps the words, seed, pictures and settings, runs below live and settle, and lands as a child snapshot; Keep takes the highest.
Split panels are one batched job; a panel is (seed, index), and only the picked one settles.
Every template shows one size control from its slots: its own aspect choice, or aspect chips over its width and height.
